WITH local AS (
                SELECT date_trunc('day', NOW() AT TIME ZONE $1)
                       + make_interval(days => $2, hours => $3, mins => $4) AS at
            )
            SELECT CASE
                     WHEN (at AT TIME ZONE $1) <= NOW() THEN (at + interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE $1
                     ELSE at AT TIME ZONE $1
                   END AS "at!"
            FROM local
